subsystems.name: app-package-boundary
subsystems.note: The app package composes build-time and runtime imports through package-name and virtual-module strings; Codemap cannot follow those resolver contracts across a consumer's Vite graph. The standalone consumer gate exercises the published exports.

subsystems.name: release-artifact-boundary
subsystems.note: The manifest, release script, and workflow form a non-imported contract for the exact published artifact; Codemap cannot follow CI strings, npm auth policy, or tarball allowlists.
